title: spec-driven-stories phase-output cache schema (Sprint 3)
description: Per-phase JSON cache files at tmp/${SESSION_ID}/phase-outputs/phase-NN.json. Each file is a standalone instance of ONE phase-output definition (phase01Output..phase07Output below). Every file carries its own 'schema_version' and 'phase_id' fields at the instance root; 'phase_id' MUST match the filename's NN suffix. Unknown phase_id or schema_version mismatch => cache miss, re-compute (no HALT, writer continues).

phase01Output.description: Phase 01 (Story Discovery) output. Writer: phase-01 exit. Readers: phase-05 (provenance), phase-06 (epic linking).

epic_content.description: Raw epic file content captured at Phase 01.3 write-time. Downstream phases may reference this instead of re-reading from disk. Phase 06 may edit the epic file after Phase 05; Phase 07.2.5 MUST re-read from disk, not from this cache. POST-EPIC-EDIT RE-READ CAVEAT.

phase02Output.description: Phase 02 (Requirements Analysis) output. Writer: phase-02 exit. Readers: phase-05 (AC embedding), phase-07 (AC fidelity).

implementation_xml_blocks.description: Per-AC <implementation> XML blocks, CDATA preserved. Sprint 2 mandates inline embedding in story file.

phase03Output.description: Phase 03 (Technical Specification) output. Writer: phase-03 exit. Readers: phase-05 (parsed_manifest reuse, tech spec rendering).

parsed_manifest.description: SECTION_MANIFEST YAML parsed once at Phase 03.6 and reused by Phase 05.2. Contains sections[] with name/header_level/status entries. NULL when Phase 03.6 conditional branch (feature story, >=5 pts) did not execute.

phase04Output.description: Phase 04 (UI Specification) output. Writer: phase-04 exit (always written, even when ui_detected=false for uniform fallback logic). Readers: phase-05 (UI spec embedding).

phase05Output.description: Phase 05 (Story File Creation) output. Writer: phase-05 exit. Readers: phase-07 (structure validation).

parsed_manifest.description: Same shape as phase-03.parsed_manifest. Populated only on cache miss (schema_version mismatch or phase-03.json missing or phase-03.parsed_manifest is null).

phase06Output.description: Phase 06 (Epic/Sprint Linking) output. Writer: phase-06 exit. Readers: phase-07 (linkage verification). NOTE: Phase 06 MUTATES the epic file via Edit(). After this phase, phase-01.epic_content is STALE. Phase 07.2.5 (AC-fidelity) MUST re-read from disk.

epic_content_cache.description: Optional post-edit snapshot. If a downstream phase needs the mutated content, read this instead of re-reading from disk.

epic_cache_stale.description: Sentinel flag set TRUE after Phase 06.1 edits the epic. Readers MUST re-read from disk when this is true.

phase07Output.description: Phase 07 (Self-Validation) output. Writer: phase-07 exit. No downstream readers in Sprint 3 scope; consumed by phase-08 completion reporter.
